title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
description: Toolformer demonstrated that a language model can learn to use external APIs (calculator, calendar, Wikipedia search, translation) by generating its own training data: sample potential API calls from its own completions, execute them, keep insertions that reduce perplexity, and fine-tune on the result. No human annotations required.
authors: Schick, Dwivedi-Sah, Dessì, Raileanu, Lomeli, Zettlemoyer, Cancedda, Scialom (Meta AI)
